quests.title: Out through the door
quests.ask: Fill in `go_to_gem()`: from the start, it should take the robot through the gap in the wall and leave it standing on the gem.
quests.nudge: Trace the path with your finger first. Where does the robot have to change direction?

quests.title: Back home, facing east
quests.ask: Fill in `come_home()`: from the gem's cell, facing east, it should bring the robot back to its starting cell, facing east again.
quests.nudge: Getting there is not the end. Which way is the robot facing when it arrives?
